facades.name: tkalciceva_otto_frank
facades.source: Street View Jul 2025 (rectified from hand-picked frames of an official pano)
facades.look: a two-storey old town house on the east side of Tkalčićeva in cream-white plaster with worn patchy walls, seen from the west. Three bays of small rectangular windows with dark brown wooden frames and brown surrounds under a deep eaves cornice with a steel rain gutter, above it a steep brown-red clay-tile roof band with two small dormers with red-brown frames. Ground floor: a long grey-taupe retractable awning across the whole front carrying the small round logo and 'RÖMERQUELLE' at the LEFT end and the script name 'Otto&Frank' in dark letters at the RIGHT-centre; under it dark open café fronts with black chalkboards, dark arched doorway, a blue shopfront and a cash machine at the far RIGHT. Copy the lettering exactly, no other text. Draw NO people, NO parked cars, NO trees, NO street furniture, NO map interface overlay, NO round map icons.
